NarrativeRVMarine:
Excessive spatter (dots on the wall) due to excessive heat. It's also undercut -- top edge of the top edge is grooved out. Big reason for things to become weak or break.

Middle weld has some porosity in it that you can see in the holes along the top from gas bubbles. Gas bubbles pop up through from contamination as gas gets trapped. Gas comings up slow instead of as fast as it normally would which creates the little ciricles.
